_README: Presentation settings - you can customize how your slideshow works here!

presentation._autoPlayHelp: Set to true to auto-advance slides, false to require manual clicks
presentation._showControlsHelp: Set to false to hide the control bar at the bottom
presentation._showKeyboardHintsHelp: Set to false to hide the keyboard shortcut hints

timing._comment: How long each slide shows (in milliseconds). 1000 = 1 second

animations._enabledHelp: Set to false to disable all animations (good for slower computers)
animations._treeGrowthDurationHelp: How long the tree takes to grow (milliseconds)

map._showPinLabelsHelp: Show country names on the map pins
